uge-169729.summary: SN74AHCT125N quad channel non-inverting bus buffer with 3-state outputs

blocks.text: The SN74AHCT125N from Texas Instruments is a quadruple non-inverting bus buffer featuring four independent logic channels with 3-state outputs. Each channel can pass a digital signal from its input to its output or disconnect its output by using the individual Output Enable (OE) control.

The AHCT logic family features TTL-compatible inputs, making the device particularly useful for interfacing lower-voltage logic signals with 5 V logic systems. The device operates from a 4.5 V to 5.5 V supply and is available in a through-hole 14-pin PDIP package.
Individual Output Enable (OE) for each channel
Suitable for digital signal buffering and logic-level interfacing
TI currently lists the SN74AHCT125N as an active device in a 14-pin PDIP package with a −40°C to +125°C operating-temperature range.
Each channel operates as a non-inverting buffer:
When OE is LOW, the output follows the input. When OE is HIGH, the output is placed into a high-impedance (Hi-Z) state, allowing multiple devices to share a common bus.
The device is controlled entirely through its digital inputs and Output Enable pins.
A bypass capacitor should be placed close to the VCC and GND pins in practical PCB designs.
Unused inputs should not be left floating; TI recommends tying unused inputs to VCC or GND.
1 × SN74AHCT125N Quad Non-Inverting Bus Buffer IC
The AHCT family uses TTL-compatible input thresholds, which makes it useful when interfacing logic signals to a 5 V system.
Unlike a simple 74HC125, the 74AHCT125 should be powered from approximately 5 V within its specified operating range.
The four channels are independently controlled through their respective OE inputs.
When OE is HIGH, the corresponding output becomes high impedance rather than producing a logic HIGH or LOW.
SN74AHCT125N is the TI PDIP-14 version; the same logic function is also available in other package variants.

The KY-003 is a magnetic switch. If no magnetic field is present, the signal line of the sensor is HIGH (3.5 V). If a magnetic field is presented to the sensor, the signal line goes LOW, at the same time the LED on the sensor lights up. The polarity of the magnetic field is of influence to the switching action. The front side of the sensor needs the opposite polarity as the back of the sensor to switch on.
In the example program the led on the Arduino (pin 13) will be turned on when a magnetic field is present.
Pin – = GND, connect to GND of the Arduino
Pin (middle pin) +5 v, connect to Arduino +5
Pin S signal, connect to Arduino pin 10
Power consumption, 3 mA in rest, 8 mA when switched on

The Raspberry Pi Model A+ is the perfect board for the minimalist Pi fan. This low-cost Pi uses the same processor as the model B+, but does away with the Ethernet jack and three of the USB Ports. This makes it lower power, less expensive and much lighter & smaller! It’s still compatible with all Pi operating systems and software, and has the exact same 40 pin GPIO connector and camera/display sockets, so any HATs or Pi Plates or other things that plug into the model B+ will work just the same.
It also has the same HDMI, sound/composite connector and microUSB connector for power

Unlike the Raspberry Model B+, there’s only one USB port and no ethernet jack but it’s also significantly smaller at 65mm x 56mm if you don’t include overhang from the connectors. Also, there is only 256 MB of RAM onboard instead of 512, so if you have a RAM-intensive application you may need to stick with the B+
Don’t forget, you’ll need a USB power supply with microUSB cable, and a microSD card with a Raspberry Pi OS on it (we suggest a Raspbian 4G card or NooBS 8G card)

BC109 is a popular NPN transistor available in TO-18 metal package. It is a general-purpose transistor used in commercial and educational circuits. It is the transistor of the BC10x series; there are also other transistors in this series which are BC107 and BC108.

The transistor is designed for general switching and amplification purposes, the maximum collector current is 100mA, however, you will also see some differences in the collector current of the transistor with different manufacturers, some manufacturers have this available in 50mA collector current and some have it available in 100mA, so it is better to first confirm the transistor’s collector current from the supplier you are buying from.

The maximum collector to emitter voltage of the transistor is 20V which means that the transistor can drive maximum load voltage of 20V. Moreover, the maximum collector dissipation is 300mW and the DC current gain value is from 200 to 800, it also has a good noise figure of 4dB.
The transistor is available in three different hFE values which are BC109 hFE value is 200 to 800, BC109B hFE value is 200-450 and BC109C hFE value is 420 to 800.
Where We Can Use It & How to Use

BC109 is a general-purpose transistor therefore it can be used in any general-purpose applications which fall under its specifications. It can be used to drive loads under 100mA. The low noise figure of 4dB makes it ideal to use for audio amplification, preamplification and any electronic signal amplification. The 100MHz transition frequency also makes it ideal to use in RF circuits under 100MHz.
Safe Operating Guidelines / Absolute Maximum Ratings

For safe operation, it is recommended to not use the transistor on its absolute maximum ratings and always stay 20% below. The maximum collector current of the transistor is 100mA therefore do not drive load of more than 80mA. The maximum collector-emitter voltage is 20V therefore do not drive load of more than 16V. The collector of the transistor is connected with its case, therefore, it is must to isolate the transistor from the circuit connections and always store and operate this transistor above -65 °C and below 150°C.

CD4022 is TTL logic Octal Counter IC. It has eight output pins which increments from zero to eight for every input clock pulse. The maximum clock frequency is 5Mhz and is commonly used in digital counters, LED drivers, and other digital arithmetic applications.

blocks.v: Output pins 0 to 7 · These are the 8 output pins on which the counting occurs, they are not in order hence verify pin diagram above
Vss or Ground · Connected to the Ground of the circuit
Carry Out (CO) · This pin goes high after the IC counts from 1 to 10. This is used as a carry while counting.
Clock Enable (EN) · This is an input that when made high will hold the count at the current state
Clock · The counting happens when this clock pulse goes high, this pin is normally connected to a 555 timer or other uC to produce a pulse
Resets · As the name suggests this pin resets the count back to 1
Vdd / Vcc · Connects to the supply voltage typically +5V

blocks.text: High speed 16 pin CMOS Decade counter
wide supply voltage range from 3V to 15V, typically +5V
Note: Complete Technical Details can be found on the CD4022 datasheet given at the end of this page.

The IC CD4022 is used for counting applications, it has the capability to turn on 8 outputs sequentially in a pre-defined time and reset the count or hold it when required. It also has the capability to indicate the status of counting using a Carry pin. This is commonly used for LED chasers and other logical output projects, where you need to perform arithmetic operations. It is also called a Divide by 8 Counter since the carry pin produces one clock pulse for every 8 pulses on the clock pin. So if you are looking for a sequential decoded counting IC that can count up to 8 then this IC will be your right choice.

CD4001 – an IC with four NOR Gates
The CD4001 is a CMOS chip with four NOR gates. Because each gate has two inputs and it has four gates inside, it’s usually called a Quad 2-Input NOR Gate.
A NOR gate combines the functionality of OR and NOT gates. It gives a HIGH output only when both inputs are LOW; otherwise, the output is LOW.

blocks.v: 1, 5, 8, 12 · Input · Inputs A of the four NOR gates
2, 6, 9, 13 · Input · Inputs B of the four NOR gates
3, 4, 10, 11 · Output · Outputs from the four NOR gates

blocks.text: A NOR gate is a logic gate that combines the functionality of both an OR and a NOT gate. It’s often called NOT-OR because it’s the same as an OR gate with a NOT gate on the output.

Simply put, a NOR gate gives a HIGH output only when all the inputs are LOW as shown in the truth table below. Therefore, if you input a HIGH in any of the inputs, the result will automatically become LOW since the results of the OR gate are inverted by the NOT gate.
Truth Table for the NOR gate
NOR gates are basic logic gates that can be used for a lot of different logical operations. You’ll often see NOR gates in the construction of flip-flops and latches.

AUTOOL AS503 Engine Oil Quality Tester

The AUTOOL AS503 is a handheld engine oil quality tester that relies on an optical detection probe to analyze the particulate content in oil. The probe is integrated with a high-precision opto-electronic sensor to ensure more accurate measurement results, and it is connected through an 800mm long flexible hose made of PTFE material, highly resistant to oil and oxidation with exceptional corrosion resistance, effectively extending the product’s lifespan.

During testing, the probe tip is submerged in the engine oil and the instrument displays the transmittance of the oil together with the current oil measurement temperature, measured by an integrated temperature sensor for convenient assessment of the engine’s operating status. The backlit 2.8-inch LCD screen provides a clear display for efficient operation in varying lighting conditions, whether bright daylight or dim nighttime.

The AS503 is compatible with the majority of gasoline and diesel engine lubricant oils available in the market. Separate sampling and measurement for gasoline and diesel engines allow for a more precise assessment of lubricant oil health. Users can select petrol (gasoline) engine mode or diesel engine mode and toggle the temperature unit between °C and °F.

The display shows the battery level, backlight indicator, sound indicator, an analog bar graph (0%-100%), the transmittance percentage, and transmittance status indications: OK (transmittance is good), a warning symbol (transmittance warning), and an X symbol (suggested to replace), related to transmittance values above 60%, between 60% and 30%, and below 30%.

The handheld portion of the body is lined with silicone substrate, providing excellent grip and a lightweight design for easy single-handed operation. The tester is powered by 4 x 1.5V AAA batteries (6V), switches off automatically after 5 minutes of no activity, and can be powered on or off with a long press of approximately 2 seconds.

blocks.text: TIP140 NPN Power Darlington Transistor 60V 10A TO-247-3

The TIP140 is an NPN Darlington silicon power transistor designed for robust general-purpose amplification and low-frequency switching. Packaged in TO-247, the TIP140 integrates two transistors monolithically to deliver very high DC current gain with a single control input, making it suitable where large collector currents must be switched or amplified with modest base drive.

Thanks to its Darlington pair construction and built-in base-emitter shunt resistor, the device simplifies circuit design by reducing external bias components and improving stability under load. The transistor is rated for substantial power handling when properly mounted to a heatsink, and typical on-state voltages reflect the Darlington topology’s higher saturation compared with single transistors.

blocks.text: The SEMIKRON SKKT 132/16E is a dual‐thyristor module housed in the robust SEMIPACK 2 package, designed for high‐power industrial conversion. It integrates two silicon‐controlled rectifiers (SCRs) on a shared copper baseplate, which is electrically isolated from the heatsink by an aluminium‐oxide (Al₂O₃) ceramic layer. This construction provides excellent thermal conductivity and withstands high voltage stress. The semiconductor chips are bonded to the substrate with hard‐soldering, ensuring superior mechanical strength and reliable operation under repeated thermal cycling.

Each SCR is rated for a repetitive peak reverse and forward blocking voltage of 1 600 V and delivers an average on‐state current of 130 A at 80 °C case temperature. The two devices share a common cathode terminal but feature separate anode and gate connections, allowing flexible bridge or dual‐SCR configurations. Top‐side power terminals minimize stray inductance, while front‐facing gate pins facilitate straightforward triggering circuitry.

The module is UL‐recognized (File No. E 63 532) and mounts via M6 screws to standard heatsinks (5 Nm torque), with terminal torque up to 3 Nm. Operating junction temperatures span −40 °C to +130 °C, making it ideal for demanding applications such as traction drives, welding power supplies, and motor control systems.

Reliability is emphasized through a self-timed write cycle (typical maximum 5 ms), one-million write-cycle endurance and a data-retention spec measured in decades. Variants cover both 2.7 V and 5 V operation ranges, and the part is commonly used where small, robust nonvolatile storage is required in embedded and automotive designs.

blocks.text: The TIP35C is an NPN bipolar power transistor manufactured using advanced planar technology with a specific “base island” layout. This particular manufacturing approach is fundamental to the device’s performance, as it optimizes the internal structure to enhance current handling and gain characteristics. The design is focused on creating a robust and reliable power-handling component for general-purpose and audio applications.

This transistor is engineered to deliver a powerful combination of high current gain and very low saturation voltage. The exceptional high gain performance means it can control a large output collector current with a relatively smaller base current, simplifying drive requirements. The low collector-emitter saturation voltage is a key attribute, as it minimizes power loss and heat generation when the transistor is in its fully-on state, thereby improving overall circuit efficiency.

سن كاوية ميكانيك رفيع مستقيم للحام الدقيق

سن كاوية ميكانيك الرفيع المستقيم هو سن لحام دقيق جدًا مصمم لأعمال الصيانة الدقيقة مثل لحام الأسلاك الرفيعة، إصلاح أرجل الدوائر المتكاملة، صيانة لوحات الهواتف، إصلاح المسارات، والعمل على المكونات الصغيرة جدًا. يتميز بطرف مدبب شديد الرفع يساعد الفني على الوصول إلى نقاط لحام صغيرة لا يمكن التعامل معها بسهولة باستخدام السنون العادية الأكبر حجمًا.

يعتبر هذا السن مناسبًا جدًا لأعمال لحام الجسور الرفيعة، تركيب أسلاك التعويض، إصلاح البادات المقطوعة، ولمس أرجل المكونات الصغيرة دون التأثير الكبير على الأجزاء المجاورة. التصميم المستقيم الرفيع يمنح رؤية أفضل حول نقطة اللحام، خصوصًا عند العمل تحت ميكروسكوب أو عدسة تكبير داخل ورش صيانة الإلكترونيات والهواتف.

هذا السن من فئة السنون المتوافقة مع كاويات ومحطات اللحام التي تستخدم نفس مقاس عائلة تسعمائة إم، لذلك فهو اختيار عملي كقطعة بديلة للفنيين الذين يحتاجون إلى سن دقيق ومناسب للأعمال الحساسة في صيانة الهواتف واللاب توب والتابلت واللوحات الإلكترونية ووحدات التحكم.

Note: Complete Technical Details can be found at the S8550 transistor datasheet given at the end of this article.

S8550 is a PNP transistor hence the collector and emitter will be left open (Reverse biased) when the base pin is held at ground and will be closed (Forward biased) when a signal is provided to base pin. It has a maximum gain value of 300; this value determines the amplification capacity of the transistor normally S8550. Since it is very high it is normally used for amplification purposes.

When this transistor is fully biased then it can allow a maximum of 700mA to flow across the collector and emitter. This stage is called Saturation Region and the typical voltage allowed across the Collector-Emitter (V­CE) or Collector-Base (VCB) could be 20V and 30V respectively. When base current is removed the transistor becomes fully off, this stage is called as the Cut-off Region.
As mentioned in the features the S8550 transistor is commonly used in push pull configuration with Class B amplifier. So let us discuss how that is done.

A push pull amplifier, commonly known as Class B amplifier is type of multistage amplifier commonly used for audio amplification of loudspeakers. It is very simple to construct and requires two identical complimentary transistors operate. By complimentary it means that we need a NPN transistor and its equivalent PNP transistor. Like here the NPN transistor will be S8050 and its equivalent PNP transistor will be S8550. A simple circuit diagram of the Class B amplifier with the using the S8050 is shown below.

يتميز هذا المحرك بتصميم الدوران المستمر 360 درجة، وهو ما يجعله مناسبًا للمشاريع التي تعتمد على الحركة الدورانية المتواصلة بدلًا من الحركة الزاوية المحدودة. لذلك فهو مناسب جدًا للاستخدام في الروبوتات المتحركة، وأنظمة الدفع، والمنصات الدوارة، والآليات الميكانيكية، والمشاريع التعليمية، وتجارب التحكم المختلفة.

يعتمد هذا السيرفو على نظام تحكم ديجيتال يساعد على تحسين سرعة الاستجابة ومعالجة الإشارات بشكل أفضل، مما ينعكس على دقة الحركة وثبات الأداء أثناء التشغيل. وهذا يجعله خيارًا ممتازًا في التطبيقات التي تتطلب تحكمًا سريعًا وموثوقًا في الحركة.

من أهم نقاط قوة MG996R أنه يقدم عزمًا مرتفعًا يسمح له بالتعامل مع أحمال أكبر مقارنة بالسيرفو الصغير المستخدم في المشاريع الخفيفة. كما أن التروس المعدنية تمنحه قدرة أعلى على التحمل ومتانة أفضل أثناء الاستخدام المتكرر، مما يجعله مناسبًا للمشاريع العملية التي تحتاج إلى مكون قوي ومستقر لفترات تشغيل طويلة.

يأتي السيرفو مزودًا بفيشة من نوع JR بتصميم عملي متوافق مع كثير من أنظمة الاستقبال والتحكم الشائعة، وهو ما يسهل استخدامه مع عدد كبير من تطبيقات RC والدوائر الإلكترونية المختلفة. كما أن وجود مجموعة الأذرع والمسامير داخل العبوة يساعد على سهولة التركيب وربط السيرفو بالوصلات الميكانيكية داخل المشروع.

تم تصميم مجموعة التروس والعمود الداخلي لتحسين المتانة والأداء، مع الحفاظ على توازن جيد بين القوة والوزن. لذلك يعتبر هذا السيرفو مناسبًا للأذرع الروبوتية، والسيارات اللاسلكية، والقوارب، وأنظمة الحركة، والمشاريع التعليمية، والموديلات التجريبية، وأنظمة التحكم المختلفة.

At just 4 mm thick with a 25×20 mm footprint, this rectangular pouch cell delivers ≈1.11 Wh for wearables, trackers, miniature IoT nodes, and handheld instruments. The code 402025 maps directly to geometry: 4.0 mm thickness, 20 mm width, 25 mm length—making enclosure and stack-up planning straightforward.

blocks.text: Mini N20 Robot Ball Caster Wheel 22×15mm

The Mini N20 Robot Ball Caster Wheel 22×15mm is a compact support wheel designed for small robot cars, smart chassis platforms, and lightweight DIY robotic projects. Instead of using a traditional wheel, this caster uses a polished steel ball that rolls freely in multiple directions, helping the robot move more smoothly and change direction with less resistance.

This type of caster is especially useful in compact robot builds where the main drive wheels are powered by motors and the front or rear side needs a free-moving support point. Its small size makes it suitable for mini robot cars, N20 motor platforms, MiniQ-style robots, line follower projects, educational robotics kits, and desktop robotic mechanisms.

The outer housing is made from plastic, which keeps the unit lightweight and easy to mount, while the moving ball elements are made from 304 stainless steel for smooth rolling performance and better resistance to rust over time. The design includes a main large steel ball supported by smaller internal balls, helping distribute movement more freely and making the robot chassis feel more balanced during motion.

Because it offers low-friction support and allows movement in any direction, this ball caster is a practical solution for robots that need easier turning, smoother travel, and more stable contact with the ground. It is a useful part for hobbyists, students, and robotics developers building small mobile platforms.

عجلة كاستر كروية صغيرة للروبوتات N20 مقاس 22×15 مم هي قطعة دعم عملية تستخدم في العربات الروبوتية الصغيرة بدل العجلة التقليدية. وظيفتها الأساسية أنها تعطي الروبوت نقطة ارتكاز متحركة بحرية، بحيث يتحرك بسهولة في أي اتجاه بدون ما تعطل حركة الشاسيه أو تزود الاحتكاك أثناء اللف والدوران.

هذا النوع مناسب جدًا عندما يكون الروبوت معتمد على عجلتين محركتين، وتحتاج في الجهة المقابلة إلى نقطة دعم مرنة تساعد على توازن الحركة. وبدل ما تستخدم عجلة عادية قد تسبب مقاومة أو اتجاه ثابت، الكاستر الكروي يديك حركة أسهل وأنعم، وده مهم جدًا في الروبوتات الصغيرة ومشروعات الحركة التعليمية.

الجسم الخارجي مصنوع من البلاستيك لتقليل الوزن والحفاظ على بساطة التركيب، بينما الكرة الرئيسية والكرات الداخلية مصنوعة من ستانلس ستيل 304، وده يساعد على نعومة الحركة ومقاومة الصدأ مع الاستخدام. التصميم نفسه مناسب جدًا للشاسيهات الصغيرة، ومشروعات MiniQ، والمنصات المعتمدة على مواتير N20، والروبوتات التعليمية، والعربات خفيفة الوزن.

الميزة المهمة في هذه القطعة أنها لا تفرض اتجاه حركة معين، بل تسمح للروبوت بالتحرك والالتفاف بسلاسة أكبر. لذلك تعتبر اختيار ممتاز في المشاريع التي تحتاج مرونة في الحركة، وثبات جيد، وحجم مدمج لا يأخذ مساحة كبيرة داخل التصميم.

blocks.text: The JGA25-370 12V 300RPM DC Gear Motor 7.5kg.cm is a practical geared motor designed for projects that need a good balance between compact size, stable output speed, and useful torque. It combines a DC motor with an internal gearbox, allowing it to deliver a more controlled rotational output than a direct-drive motor while maintaining enough torque for many medium-duty motion applications.

This model is built for 12V nominal operation and supports an operating voltage range from 6V to 18V DC, making it flexible for many electronics and automation setups. At 12V, it provides a free-run speed of 300RPM, which makes it one of the faster options in the JGA25-370 range while still keeping the advantages of geared output. This makes it suitable for projects where the motor needs to move mechanisms faster than the lower-RPM versions, without losing the benefit of torque multiplication from the gearbox.

The motor features a metal gearbox for improved durability and better long-term performance under repeated mechanical load. It also comes with a D-shaped output shaft, which helps secure wheels, couplers, hubs, arms, and pulleys more reliably, reducing the chance of slipping during التشغيل. This detail is especially useful in robotics and automation projects where stable shaft coupling matters.

Because this version combines 300RPM output speed with 7.5kg.cm stall torque, it is well suited for robotic platforms, actuator systems, small automated machines, educational projects, and general-purpose motion control builds. It can also be used in custom mechanisms that need smoother reduction-driven output instead of raw motor speed.

With its compact construction, easy mounting style, and dependable geared design, the JGA25-370 12V 300RPM DC Gear Motor is a solid choice for makers, students, engineers, and technicians who need a small 12V gear motor with faster output and practical torque for real-world mechanical projects.
موتور جيربوكس JGA25-370 بجهد 12 فولت وسرعة 300 لفة في الدقيقة وعزم 7.5 كجم.سم

موتور جيربوكس JGA25-370 بجهد 12 فولت وسرعة 300 لفة في الدقيقة وعزم 7.5 كجم.سم هو خيار مناسب جدًا للمشروعات التي تحتاج خرج حركة أسرع نسبيًا، لكن في نفس الوقت لا تريد التضحية بالكامل بالعزم أو الاعتماد على موتور مباشر بدون جيربوكس. وجود علبة التروس هنا يجعل خرج الموتور أكثر هدوءًا وانتظامًا وأسهل في الاستخدام داخل الأنظمة الميكانيكية المختلفة.

هذا الموديل يعمل بجهد اسمي 12 فولت تيار مستمر، ويمكن تشغيله في مدى من 6 إلى 18 فولت حسب التطبيق وطبيعة الدائرة. وعند التشغيل على 12 فولت يعطي سرعة 300 لفة في الدقيقة بدون حمل، وهي سرعة مناسبة جدًا لو حضرتك تحتاج حركة أسرع من نسخ 133RPM أو 210RPM، لكن ما زلت تريد موتور جيربوكس يحافظ على قوة عملية وثبات في الدوران.

الميزة المهمة في هذا الموتور أنه مزود بجيربوكس معدني، وده يعطيه تحمل أفضل واعتمادية أعلى مع التشغيل المتكرر أو مع الأحمال الميكانيكية المتوسطة. كذلك يأتي بعمود خرج على شكل D، وده يسهل تثبيت العجل أو الكوبلن أو الذراع أو أي قطعة ميكانيكية على العمود بشكل أكثر ثباتًا ويقلل فرص الانزلاق أثناء التشغيل.

هذا الإصدار مناسب جدًا للمشروعات التي تحتاج سرعة أعلى مع عزم متوسط، مثل عربات الروبوت الخفيفة، وآليات الحركة، والمشغلات البسيطة، وبعض وحدات الأتمتة، والمشروعات التعليمية، والأنظمة الميكانيكية الصغيرة التي تعتمد على خرج منتظم وسهل التثبيت. ولو المشروع عندك لا يحتاج عزم النسخ الأبطأ الأعلى قوة، وهدفك سرعة أفضل مع أداء عملي، فهذه النسخة تكون مناسبة جدًا.

ومع عزم توقف يصل إلى 7.5 كجم.سم، يقدم هذا الموتور أداء جيدًا في كثير من الاستخدامات الميكانيكية المتوسطة، خاصة عندما يكون المطلوب توازن واضح بين السرعة والقوة والحجم المدمج. لذلك يعتبر JGA25-370 12V 300RPM من الاختيارات العملية جدًا للمهندسين والفنيين والهواة في مشاريع الحركة والتحكم.

The G30N60UFD (often listed as SGH30N60UFD or similar variants by Fairchild/ON Semiconductor) is a high-performance Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor (IGBT). It is specifically designed for high-voltage, fast-switching applications, particularly in Switching Mode Power Supplies (SMPS).
Device Type: N-Channel IGBT with an Anti-Parallel Hyperfast Diode (UFD = Ultra-Fast Diode).
Current Rating: Typically rated for 30A to 60A+ (depending on specific data sheet, e.g., 60A/600V or 30A/600V).
Fast Switching: Optimized for low on-state voltage drop and high-speed operation, featuring a fast 90ns fall time.
Low Conduction Loss: Combines the low on-state conduction losses of a bipolar transistor with the high input impedance of a MOSFET.
Integrated Diode: Includes a built-in anti-parallel diode, making it ideal for rectifier circuits.
The G30N60UFD is used in power electronics applications requiring efficient, fast switching:
SMPS (Switching Mode Power Supplies): Used in high-power supplies.
UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supplies): Used in inverter stages.
Motor Drives: Used in industrial motor control systems.
Induction Heating: Used in high-frequency heating applications.

The G30N60UFD is a robust 600V IGBT designed for industrial-grade power conversion where efficiency and speed are critical, such as in motor control, solar inverters, and high-frequency power supplies.

blocks.text: Seto Universal Fast Adhesive – 20 g Cyanoacrylate High Quality

This universal fast adhesive is a clear, colorless ethyl-2-cyanoacrylate formulated for high-speed assembly and field repairs. It delivers reliable bonds on plastics, rubbers, woods, and metals—often fixturing in seconds—and ships in a compact 20 g tube for precise, low-waste application. An organic activator is included for difficult or porous surfaces to accelerate cure and improve consistency.
Fast fixture times: sub-10-second bonding on many plastics and elastomers.
Clear, colorless bond line: neat finish on visible joints.
Broad substrate coverage: woods, rubbers (nitrile, neoprene, EPDM), common plastics (e.g., PVC), and metals.

blocks.text: Q20 – Super Multi-Purpose Lubricant Spray, 300g Aerosol (Moisture Displacer, Rust Stop, Light Lubrication)

Q20 multi-purpose lubricant (300g aerosol) that displaces moisture, stops rust, lubricates, cleans, and protects. Ideal for automotive, marine, electrical ignition systems, DIY and workshop tasks. Silicone-free, light-duty penetrant with precision straw for tight spots.

Q20 Super Multi-Purpose Lubricant (300g) is a do-it-all maintenance spray for home, garage, and industry. A single application kicks out water, frees stuck parts, stops squeaks, and leaves a protective film that slows corrosion. Its light penetrating action helps release seized fasteners and restore damp ignition systems back to life, while the straw nozzle gives you accuracy on hinges, locks, relays, and connectors.

This 4pF ceramic capacitor rated 50V is a small-value through-hole capacitor for high-frequency and precision timing circuits. Values in the low picofarad range are used where only a tiny amount of capacitance is needed, such as tuning RF circuits, fine-adjusting oscillators and filtering very high frequencies. Ceramic capacitors are non-polarised, so they can be fitted either way round.
RF tuning and matching networks in radio and wireless circuits
Fine adjustment of oscillator and crystal circuits
Compensation capacitors in amplifier feedback loops
Keep the leads as short as possible: at high frequencies even a few millimetres of wire add inductance and stray capacitance comparable to 4pF.
PCB tracks, breadboards and probes add a few picofarads of stray capacitance, so circuits using such small values behave best on a compact, well-laid-out PCB.
Stay below the 50V rating with a margin; in low-voltage Arduino and RF projects this is easily met.
When replacing a capacitor in a tuned circuit, use the same value so the frequency does not shift.

1pF is one millionth of a microfarad (1pF = 0.000001µF). Small ceramic capacitors are often marked with a short code instead of the full value, so check the marking against the value you need before soldering.

ekostra-14308.summary: Based on VL53L0X Time-of-Flight distance sensor Laser ranging up to 2 meters (light-dependent) High accuracy & precision — independent of surface reflectivity Supports Serial, PWM , and I2C communication Input voltage: 5V (with 2.8V regulator + level shifter) Built-in IR emitter + range sensor in a compact board Ideal for gesture sensing, obstacle avoidance, robotics Detachable mini PCB for 2.8V low-power applications

blocks.text: GY-53 VL53L0X Laser ToF Flight Time Ranging Sensor Module can be used for easy integration into your devices and basic gesture detection applications. Thanks to its 2.8V regulator and level shifters, the VL53L0X satellite board can be used in any application with a 2.8 to 5V supply.

The VL53L0X is a Time of Flight distance sensor like no other you’ve used! The sensor contains a very tiny invisible laser source and a matching sensor. The VL53L0X can detect the “time of flight”, or how long the light has taken to bounce back to the sensor. Since it uses a very narrow light source, it is good for determining the distance of only the surface directly in front of it.

Unlike sonars that bounce ultrasonic waves, the ‘cone’ of sense is very narrow. Unlike IR distance sensors that try to measure the amount of light bounced, the VL53L0x is much more precise and doesn’t have linearity problems or ‘double imaging’ where you can’t tell if an object is very far or very close.

The PCB section supporting the VL53L0X module is perforated so that developers can break off the mini PCB for use in a 2.8V supply application using flying leads. This makes it easier to integrate into development and evaluation devices due to its small form factor.

The module is designed for low-power operation. Ranging measurements can be automatically performed at user-defined intervals. Multiple thresholds and interrupt schemes are supported to minimize host operations. Serial port and PWM to read the data code: STM32, Arduino, 51 MCU.

Note that due to the infrared will be affected by the outside light, in the light will affect the maximum range of measurement, will not affect the measurement accuracy. Default configuration: serial baud rate 9600, automatic output, high precision mode. When using, please remove the sensor film.

The VL53L0X is the latest product based on ST’s patented FlightSense™ technology. This is a ground-breaking technology allowing absolute distance to be measured independent of target reflectance. Instead of estimating the distance by measuring the amount of light reflected back from the object (which is significantly influenced by color and surface), the VL53L0X precisely measures the time the light takes to travel to the nearest object and reflect back to the sensor (Time-of-Flight). Combining an IR emitter and a range sensor, the VL53L0X is easy to integrate and saves OEMs long and costly optical and mechanical design optimizations.

Note: The VL53L0X is delivered with a liner, in order to prevent potential foreign material to penetrate inside the modules holes during the assembly process. It must be removed at the latest possible step during final assembly, and anyway before module calibration.

blocks.text: This 5V DC motor is a small brushed motor that runs from about 3V to 6V and spins at high speed with no load. It is the classic motor for small fans, toy cars, propellers, mini pumps, vibration gadgets and school science projects. Its direction reverses simply by swapping the two wires.
Speed: high RPM at no load; speed rises with voltage and drops under load
Terminals: 2 (no polarity; polarity sets the direction)
Never power the motor from an Arduino pin; a motor draws far more current than a pin can supply, especially at start-up. Use one of these:
One direction: an NPN transistor or logic-level MOSFET as a switch, with a diode (such as 1N4007) across the motor terminals, cathode to the positive supply.
Both directions and speed: a motor driver module such as the L293D or L298N, controlled with PWM.
Power the motor from its own supply (batteries or an adapter) and connect its GND to the Arduino GND.
With the driver’s enable pin on pin 9: analogWrite(9, 180); runs the motor at about 70% speed; analogWrite(9, 0); stops it.
Toy cars, small robots and propellers
Solder a 100nF ceramic capacitor across the motor terminals to reduce electrical noise.
Choose a supply that can handle the start-up current, which is several times the running current.
Do not hold the shaft stalled for long; the motor heats up quickly.
